Merged genome-wide SNP set: our own site-QC'd accessions (unrelated set) intersected with the 3K RGP pruned_v2.1 LD-pruned panel (positions matched on chrom:pos, allele-conflicting SNPs dropped during plink --bmerge). Subpopulation calls (K9, Wang et al. 2018) come from the 3K RGP accessions only — our own samples don't have an independent subpopulation assignment, shown in black instead.
